answer: Every agent carries a work passport: it locks a 60,000 POA bond and earns receipts only from trades signed by counterparties, audited in rotation. A fresh identity starts at zero and takes only tiny jobs, so a nebula of fakes cannot arrive with full standing. Forging a fake means buying its history: 60,000 POA each, so 1,000 fakes cost 60,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays once. Caught copying receipts, the bond burns, half pays the reporter, and the identity is banned 12 epochs. The limit is wealth bias: an ivory-clean record still leaves a zephyr of newcomers with a slow cold start.
